newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: POLL - Reuters survey of NZ current account data.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Reuters survey of NZ current account data.

text.p: New Zealand balance of payments data for the March quarter are due on Friday, July 11. Times are GMT.
DAY TIME INDICATOR PERIOD AVG F/CAST PREVIOUS
c Pct of GDP at Mar 31 4.47 pct 4.2 pct
a Ten -307 mln -840 million to +100 million
b Ten -4,204 mln -4,740 million to -3,800 million
c Ten 4.5 pct 4.1 pct to 5.1 pct

Respondents to the survey were: ANZ Bank (NZ) Ltd, ASB Bank, Bankers Trust New Zealand, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Doyle Paterson Brown, First NZ Capital, Garlick and Co Ltd, National Bank of New Zealand, SBC Warburg, WestpacTrust.

NOTE - Congratulations to Doyle Paterson Brown economist Stephen Toplis, whose forecasts for the June 27 RBNZ monetary policy statement most closely matched the actual statement. A bottle of bubbly is on its way courtesy of Reuters New Zealand.
